search_help: ↑ ↓ to navigate   Enter to open   Esc to return
delete_warning: You can restore this note from Recently deleted.
close_unsaved_body: The note could not be saved. Retry or export a UTF-8 text file.
help_tab: Outside the editor, Tab / Shift+Tab move between controls.
help_activate: Enter / Space · activate the focused control
help_escape: Esc · close a panel or return to writing
help_editing: In the editor, Tab inserts four spaces; Shift+Tab unindents. F6 moves focus to tabs. Copy, paste, cut, select all, undo and redo are supported.
startup_body:
{error}

Existing notes were left intact. Check the data folder and try again.
error_data_directory: Could not find the local application data directory.
error_theme_path: Choose a JSON theme from the Themes folder.
error_lock: Could not lock the notes folder. Close any other Quick Note window using it and try again. {error}
error_theme_load: Theme could not be loaded. Using Helium. Fix the JSON file or choose another theme. {error}
error_theme_reload: Theme was not changed. Fix the JSON file and reload it. {error}
error_theme_action: Could not complete the action. Check the file and try again. {error}
error_export: Export failed. Choose another location and try again. {error}
error_cursor_save: Cursor position was not saved. Retry saving the note. {error}
error_save_before_switch: Save or export the current text before switching notes.
error_save_before_new: Save or export the current text before creating a note.
error_save_before_delete: Save or export the current text before deleting another note.
error_delete_selection: No note is selected for deletion.
error_save_recovery: Could not save the note. A recovery copy is available. Retry or export the text. {error}
error_save_no_recovery: Not saved. Keep this window open and export the text. {error} Recovery copy failed: {recovery_error}
error_recovery_read: Could not read the recovery copy. Keep recovery.json and check its permissions. {error}
error_recovery_decode: Could not read the recovery copy. Keep recovery.json; your saved notes are still available. {error}
error_recovery_active: Recovered text was saved, but the active tab was not restored. {error}
error_recovery_wait: Recovery is waiting. Keep recovery.json and try reopening Quick Note. {error}
error_recovery_remove: The note is saved. An older recovery copy could not be removed. {error}
error_note_missing: Note not found. Choose another note.
error_note_missing_save: Note not found. Keep this window open and export the text.
error_note_missing_delete: Note not found. Nothing was deleted.
error_schema_newer: This database needs a newer Quick Note (version {version}).
error_database_encoding: Quick Note requires a UTF-8 database. The existing file was left intact.
error_backup_path: Use a UTF-8 path for the database backup.
error_theme_size: Use a theme file smaller than 64 KB.
error_theme_version: This theme needs a different Quick Note version. Use schemaVersion 1.
error_theme_name: Give the theme a name between 1 and 60 characters.
error_theme_appearance: Set appearance to light or dark.
error_theme_color: Use a six-digit color such as #202124 instead of {value}.
error_theme_font_name: Use a font family name with 1–100 characters.
error_theme_font: The font {font} is unavailable on this computer. Choose an installed font in Settings.
error_theme_layout: Use fontSize 11–32, lineSpacing 0–24, editorPadding 12–64, and toolbarHeight 32–56.
error_language: Could not change the language. Try again. {error}
error_locale_file: Could not load the language file {path}. {error}
font_keyboard_help: ↑ ↓ to browse · Enter to add or remove
error_font_metrics: The font {font} does not provide the character widths required by the editor.
motion_hint: Use instant transitions. Your system setting takes priority.
error_motion_setting: Couldn’t save the motion setting. Try again. {error}
markdown_hint: Preview Markdown formatting. Turn off to use plain text.
error_markdown_setting: Could not save the Markdown setting: {error}
shortcuts_hint: Edit shortcut/bindings.json, then reload or return to the app.
error_shortcut_size: Use a shortcut file smaller than 64 KB.
error_shortcut_key: Invalid shortcut “{shortcut}”. Use a combination such as Primary+Shift+N.
error_shortcut_reserved: “{shortcut}” is reserved for writing and navigation. Add Primary, Ctrl or Alt, or use an F key.
error_shortcut_limit: Use at most 8 key combinations per action.
error_shortcut_conflict: “{shortcut}” is assigned to both {first} and {second}. Change one binding.
error_shortcut_load: Could not load shortcuts. Defaults are active. Fix shortcut/bindings.json and reload. {error}
error_shortcut_reload: Shortcuts were not changed. Fix shortcut/bindings.json and reload. {error}
error_shortcut_folder: Could not open the shortcuts folder. {error}
font_order_help: Fonts are tried from top to bottom. Bundled fallbacks cover remaining characters.
font_limit_reached: 8 fonts selected. Remove one to add another.
font_keep_one: Keep at least one font in the stack.
capture_hint: While the app is running, {shortcut} opens a note from any app. Escape returns to your work.

capture.clipboard_empty: The clipboard has no text to save.
capture.login_requires_approval: Allow Quick Note in Login Items to finish enabling this option.
capture.login_unavailable: Available when running the installed Quick Note.app.
